horizon_meaning: input clip always ends at frame `end_frame` (=t, never sees later frames); horizon_s=0 decodes the graph AT t (nowcast, no future info); horizon_s=1/4 decode the graph 1s/4s AFTER t (true future prediction)
split: leave-one-take-out (6 folds), inner GroupShuffleSplit(test_size=0.2) for threshold validation

variants.exo_vjepa2: mean of V-JEPA 2 features over available exo cameras (external_1..5, microscope)
variants.ego_surgmotion: mean of SurgMotion features over available ego cameras (head_surgeon, assistant, circulator, anesthetist)
variants.all_vjepa2: concat(V-JEPA 2 exo mean, V-JEPA 2 ego mean) -- single-encoder baseline
variants.all_surgmotion: concat(SurgMotion exo mean, SurgMotion ego mean) -- single-encoder baseline
variants.dual_fusion: concat(V-JEPA 2 exo mean, SurgMotion ego mean) -- the proposed dual-encoder design
variants.reverse_fusion: concat(SurgMotion exo mean, V-JEPA 2 ego mean) -- opposite assignment, negative control
